Determine whether the following matrices are diagonalizable. If so, find matrices $D$ and $P$ such that $A=PDP^{-1}$.

$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} -2 \amp -2 \\ -2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} -1 \amp 1 \\ -1 \amp -3 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 3 \amp -4 \\ 2 \amp -1 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 2 \amp -2 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 4 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rrr} 1 \amp 2 \amp 2 \\ 2 \amp 1 \amp 2 \\ 2 \amp 2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] $.
